Pranav V. has already won the World Junior title in 2025. Well, the youngster wasn't satisfied with it. He decided to play at the World Junior Rapid and Blitz Championships 2026 in Al Ain, UAE. While Pranav won the silver in rapid, it was his chance to win the gold in blitz. This is the final round of the event. Pranav takes on IM Alexander Khripachenko. Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
